messages:
Bea (Head of Product): Following up from today's all-hands Q&A 7: capture the succinct why for recent wins and losses + next steps. Drop one-line notes or quick replies.
Marco (Sales Ops): Sales quick take: Win = ad platform picked Dedicated after seeing stable tail latency in our stress test. Loss = insurance POC required customer-managed HSM + deterministic audit trail; they pulled procurement.
Rae (Customer Success): Two recurring asks in renewal conversations: extended log retention (legal wants 7 years for some customers) and clearer guidance on data flow for Private deployments.
Ibrahim (SE): Tech detail on the loss: the insurance team needed signed per-response proofs and an auditable key custody flow. Our SDK demo showed feasibility but they needed an official design+timeline.
Luca (Infra): On the tail latency win: the demo used tenant-isolated queues + a small prewarmed worker pool which reduced burst p99 by ~120ms. For losses, cold-start after autoscale is the consistent complaint.
Marco (Sales Ops): Top blockers I'm tracking: 1) customer-managed KMS/HSM 2) retention tiers and archival pricing 3) signed response / non-repudiation options 4) a single-page "how we meet audits" doc for procurement. Those resolve most stalled deals.
Bea (Head of Product): Good. Proposed triage windows: 30d items (attestation template, one-pager, retention toggle), 60d items (signed-response prototype, KMS integration plan). We need concrete owners.
Rae (Customer Success): Actionable: I can compile 10 recent losses with verbatim customer asks and procurement language in 48h. That should help Legal/Prod scope attestations.
Ibrahim (SE): I'll draft a signed-response API sketch (options: HMAC with customer key, Redwood-signed JWT chain) + perf estimate. Target 5 days for an initial doc.
Luca (Infra): Will prototype a warm-standby pool and run a burst-resilience test matrix. ETA: 7 days for reproducible numbers and cost delta.
Tara (Security Bot): Reminder: any attestation must include scope, expiration, and Security sign-off. Template v0.1 is in /security/attestations/attest-v0.1 for review.
Marco (Sales Ops): Sales ask: can Legal approve short-term scoped attestations for high-priority accounts while we build long-term KMS support? That shortens cycles.
Ellen (CEO): We can approve scoped attestations case-by-case if Product + Security sign the scope and expiration. Long-term priority remains customer-managed keys. Bea, include criteria in the GH issue.
Bea (Head of Product): Will do. Action owners recap: - Rae: lost-deals spreadsheet (48h) - Ibrahim: signed-response design + perf (5d) - Luca: warm-pool perf + cost (7d) - Security: finalize attestation template (48h). I'll create the GH project and invite Legal + Security + Sales.
Marco (Sales Ops): Also request: sales one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private controls (quick procurement checklist). Need in 10 business days.
Rae (Customer Success): I'll include a couple of customer quotes and procurement Qs in the spreadsheet to make the ask concrete.
Ibrahim (SE): For the signed-response sketch, question for Security: do we allow Redwood-held signing keys for interim solutions or must customers always provide keys?
Tara (Security Bot): Interim Redwood-held keys acceptable with documented expiration and customer consent, but we prefer customer-managed keys for long-term contracts. Details in template.
Bea (Head of Product): Scheduling: 30-min triage sync Friday 09:00 PT after GH is created. Please keep replies concise so we can convert this into owners + issues quickly. :rocket:
